worker_claim.report: The transaction is intentionally not wired into scheduler admission because downstream execution still assumes ticket-scoped workspace identity; enabling it before those paths are converted would be unsafe. The positive transaction fixture passes without a failure-cache entry, but the ordinary scheduler fixture remains xfailed at its first run-worker status assertion. Local full coverage passed with that xfail; the earlier checkpoint's GitHub Actions run completed successfully.
worker_claim.summary: Added a journaled isolated target transaction that creates a generation-specific branch, attaches its worktree, and publishes its remote ref with an expected-absent lease. Added a disposable real-Git test covering the transaction and restart at several journal boundaries while preserving historical evidence.
